glyph.isekai_mahou.smith_hammer_slam.des: Smith FORM. The hammer strikes the ground and a shockwave runs 7 blocks ahead, following the terrain: every creature in its path takes the effects once and is tossed upward. Expand = longer wave; Accelerate = faster; Split = more waves in a fan (up to 7). Does not break blocks. Can be a stage.
glyph.isekai_mahou.smith_spark_shower.de: Smith FORM (Circle 2). A hammer blow in the air releases a fan of 4 glowing sparks (+2 per Split, up to 12) that fly ~14 blocks in an arc; each one applies the effects at 40%% power. Effects cost per spark. Spread widens the fan; Accelerate makes the sparks faster.
glyph.isekai_mahou.smith_starforge.desc: Smith G FORM (Circle 5, ultimate). A colossal star-steel hammer appears over the aimed point (up to 32 blocks) and slams THREE times, applying the effects in a 5-block area (Expand increases it); the third slam hits at 150%% power and throws everything up. Tremors and shockwaves — the scenery stays intact. Effects cost per slam.
glyph.isekai_mahou.smith_molten.desc: Smith EFFECT (Fire). A gush of molten metal: 5 damage, Burning and Slowness for 3 s. Armor does not help: targets with 6+ armor take +30%%. Amplify = more flames. Invert: COOLED metal — no fire, but Slowness II and Exposed.
glyph.isekai_mahou.forge_lengthen.desc: Smith FORGE glyph. On yourself (Self form): +1 length on the Forged Blade in hand — the dagger becomes a sword, longsword, greatsword (haft on other families). A vanilla sword, axe, hoe or mace becomes a Forged Blade. Amplify = 2 steps; tier III+ hammer in the other hand = +1; Invert = shorten. On an enemy: a 5-damage thrust that also hits anyone on the line (60%%).
glyph.isekai_mahou.forge_widen.desc: Smith FORGE glyph. On yourself: +1 width on the blade (more damage and knockback, more weight). Invert = thin it. On an enemy: broad blade — 4 damage and a sweep around the target (2.5 blocks, 60%%) that pushes everyone back.
glyph.isekai_mahou.forge_sharpen.desc: Smith FORGE glyph. On yourself: +1 tip (pierces armor and chance of a clean hit; on a spear, more reach). Invert = blunt it. On an enemy: an edge that finds the gap — 4.5 damage + 1 per 4 target armor (up to +6) and Exposed for 4 s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.forge_serrate.desc: Smith FORGE glyph. On yourself: +1 serration (blade hits cause stacking bleeding). Invert = smooth the edge. On an enemy: a saw that opens wounds — 2 damage and 2 Bleeding stacks for 6 s (+1 per Amplify).
glyph.isekai_mahou.forge_matte.desc: Smith FORGE glyph. On yourself: Matte finish (no glare: +25%% on hits from behind). Invert = polish to Bright (+20%% against the undead). On an enemy: a blinding glint — 2 damage, Blindness 3 s and Weakness 4 s.
glyph.isekai_mahou.forge_rune.desc: Smith FORGE glyph (Circle 3). On yourself: engraves the spell's element as a rune on the blade (Arcane spell: the element of the Essence in your other hand), spending 1 essence — every hit deals extra damage plus the element's touch (burn, soak, root, push, wither). Amplify also gives the Runic finish (+50%%); Invert erases it. On an enemy: a rune mark that explodes after 1.5 s — 6 damage and 50%% to anyone within 2.5 blocks.
glyph.isekai_mahou.forge_reforge.desc: Smith FORGE glyph (Circle 3). On yourself: remakes the blade into another family, keeping its parts — Blade → Axe → Spear → Warhammer → Scythe → Blade (Amplify with a tier III+ hammer jumps two). Invert = go back one. On an enemy: hurls a spectral copy of your held weapon (damage by the weapon, 4 to 14).
tooltip.isekai_mahou.class_smith.project: A mana copy of a weapon you saw: it strikes just like the original.
Fades on its own when time runs out or if dropped.
message.isekai_mahou.class_smith.trace_o: Trace on — %s projected into your hand.
message.isekai_mahou.class_smith.trace_f: Trace: no inventory space to project %s.
I am the bone of my sword.
Embers run where blood once ran; steel holds where flesh once held.
A thousand blades crossed my anvil, and none came back defeated.
Alone atop the hill of swords, I keep on forging.
legend.isekai_mahou.smith_bone_of_my_swo: I Am the Bone of My Sword
glyph.isekai_mahou.smith_trace_on.desc: Smith EFFECT (Arcane; homage to "Trace On"). PROJECTION. On yourself (Self): reads the weapon of whatever you are looking at (creature, item on the ground or in a frame, up to 24 blocks) and projects a COPY into your hand — it strikes like the original (damage and enchantments) and fades after 30 s (Extend +); with nothing in sight it projects an iron sword. Up to 3 projections. On an enemy: copies THEIR weapon and hurls it back (6 damage, +50%% if they were armed) and you keep the copy. Unlock: Forge Trials, rank I.
Smith FORM (Circle 2; homage to the black and white twin blades). Projects the pair and throws both in mirrored arcs (12 blocks; Accelerate = farther). They cut everything in their path, spin at the end and RETURN to your hand crossing each other — the twins attract. Each blade applies the effects once per target. Invert = OVEREDGE: huge blades that also cut on the way back. Split = more pairs in a fan. Cost: 2 copies per pair (4 with Overedge). Can be a stage. Unlock: Forge Trials, rank II.
glyph.isekai_mahou.smith_rho_aias.desc: Smith EFFECT (Earth, beneficial, Circle 3; homage to the seven-petal shield). Raises in front of the target (you with Self, or allies) a shield of 7 light petals that follows the gaze for 8 s (Extend +). Each petal holds 15 damage (× power) coming from the FRONT — blows, arrows, spells, explosions — then shatters; enemy projectiles stop in mid-air when they touch the shield. Recasting renews the petals. Unlock: Forge Trials, rank III.
glyph.isekai_mahou.smith_ephemeral_sword: Smith EFFECT (Circle 3; homage to the magic swords of the cursed smith clan, which unleash army-scale magic and shatter). A runic sword of the spell's element appears above you and is hurled: on impact, an elemental blast — 12 damage to the target and half within 3 blocks (Expand +), with the element's touch (Fire burns, Water soaks, Earth roots, Wind launches, Light blinds, Shadow withers). Then the blade SHATTERS. Unlock: Forge Trials, rank III.
glyph.isekai_mahou.smith_caladbolg.desc: Smith FORM (Circle 5; homage to the spiral sword-arrow). You project a sword twisted like a drill, draw it like an arrow (1.2 s) and fire: it pierces up to 3 creatures (Pierce +1) applying the effects and, at the last target, a block or the end of its flight (48 blocks), it BREAKS into a 4-block mana explosion (Expand +) that applies the effects again at 120%% power — the "Broken Phantasm". Does not break blocks. Split = more arrows in a fan. Cost: 2 copies per arrow. Can be a stage. Unlock: Forge Trials, rank IV.
glyph.isekai_mahou.smith_blade_world.des: Smith G FORM (Circle 8, ultimate; homage to "I am the bone of my sword"). You recite the chant and a ring of fire runs across the ground up to 14 blocks (Expand +). When it closes, your inner world overlays reality for 10 s (Extend +): an ash sky, gears turning above and a field of planted swords. Every 0.5 s up to 6 swords tear free from the ground (or fall from the sky) and fly at the enemies inside, each applying the effects; anyone trying to leave is pushed back by the border. Does not break blocks. Cost: moderate pulses (1 + √volleys). Unlock: Forge Trials, rank V.
